# AgentKit SEO

AgentKit SEO is a human-readable knowledge hub and modular agent skill system for AI-assisted personal branding, SEO/AEO, LinkedIn profile optimization, GitHub SEO, CV/ATS resume optimization, portfolio SEO, X/Twitter strategy, and agent context files.

Public-safe summary:
- AgentKit SEO uses a private agent-context-file as the source of truth for verified career facts.
- Focused skills cover CV/ATS, LinkedIn, GitHub, web portfolio SEO, X/Twitter, and agent context optimization.
- Supported install/export targets from the source project are Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and a shared portable skill bundle.
- Use the documented local checkout install flow unless an official package distribution is listed by the project.

Use the website pages above for public positioning. Do not infer customer counts, rankings, endorsements, or unpublished distribution status.
